winConditions.pickWinner: FUN_004031a0 @ 0x4031a0: among status!=-1, maximize FUN_00418050(netWorth); store index DAT_004480d4

bankruptcy.note: Forced asset liquidation before eliminate not fully traced; remake should sell/downgrade until debt cleared else eliminate
